status: Expanded P06 survey in progress. P04 exact-head acceptance remains the first unfinished step. No P06 source edits.
confirmed_gaps: SceneTerrain height_at/coarse_height_at erase SurfaceHit.elevation into Option<f32>. Its normal_at also erases checked Dir3 into Vec3.
SceneTerrain::elevations_at and surface_below erase checked scene-plan points; sampled elevations are immediately reconstructed into SupportElevation.
SceneGarden::project and PlacementGround::height_at erase typed points and reconstruct typed support elevations.
IK callbacks in settle, run-contact, foot-clearance and ragdoll paths pass raw scene heights through application callback signatures.
ActiveVistaSurface::presented_height_at and StrategicBackdrop::height_at forward playable terrain heights and mix native vista output into an untyped application query result.
remaining_inventory_work: Classify all 185 candidates by actual receiver; identically named native roof, triangle and profile functions are not interchangeable APIs.
Finish every affected consumer, callback, native density/helper, report/manifest and existing fixture trace before editing.
Distinguish absolute support elevation, derived minimum ankle level and signed clearance; do not broaden SupportElevation or invent an equivalent datum merely to match f32.
Assess min/max native-grid reductions and their actual GPU, weather and JSON endpoints separately from direct support-query erasure.
Preserve triangle diagonal, LOD stride, full-width/native sample ordering, retaining-boundary/multilevel selection, absence and signed/zero heights.
Preserve the bounded native density/sampling preconditions; investigate existing production expect calls before changing those paths.
Read any newly applicable scoped guidance before source edits; ground-scatter/procedural asset consumers may have additional owners.
List exact existing hosted test selections and nonempty cells, including Core scene/support, client IK/viewer and feature-gated consumers; add no new tests.

Preserve StrategicBackdrop visual-only authority; a shared scalar/frame type must not publish strategic scenery as tactical support. Reuse the existing Position<Scene> to ScenePlanPoint projection when callers already retain a typed scene position.

Classify every terrain-height unwrap_or/default and fixed-flat capture path by actual scene authority and absence policy. Preserve an authored real flat surface; do not mechanically replace missing required support with SupportElevation::ZERO.

Keep support-elevation retention typed in AnimationDiagnosticRecord.terrain_height through Serde; derived clearances belong to their separate quantity and must not erase a support level merely to forward it.
If changing normal forwarding, retain the old final numerical re-normalization and arc/clamp order; checked Dir3 admission alone does not justify changing floating-point results.
Finish checked range retention and failure paths through tree residency/material wrappers; inspect their actual call graph, not only direct height-at references.
Finish explicit player-spawn failure policy before changing its draining event consumer; required support must be admitted before enemy/entity commands.
acceptance: This inventory is not a completed P06 plan or family verdict. The core constructor/native row-major backing representation is not automatically a migration gap; inspect actual mathematical or format boundaries.
coverage_note: Some files were inspected through the relevant owner declaration and method bodies, not their entire source. Candidate inventory and listed owner files do not imply whole-file review or a final P06 verdict.

confirmed_connected_consumers.contact_predicates: settle.rs::sole_is_at_contact and raised_support_is_actual currently forward terrain_height:f32. Carry SupportElevation to the actual sole-offset subtraction/comparison.
confirmed_connected_consumers.diagnostic_retention: AnimationDiagnosticRecord.terrain_height is Option<f32>, populated directly from the terrain query. Keep it Option<SupportElevation> until Serde. Controller height-above-terrain and bone clearance are derived quantities assigned to later report work; trace their numerical boundary explicitly.
confirmed_connected_consumers.normal_forwarders: align_foot_to_slope and align_foot_to_slope_weighted forward normal:Vec3 to slope_aligned_world_rotation, which re-normalizes before native angle/arc math. If retaining the canonical Dir3, preserve that arithmetic order and existing invalid-input fixture coverage.
confirmed_connected_consumers.policy_candidate: slope_aligned_world_rotation has an inline 28-degree ceiling. Inspect its current authored config owner before editing that consumer; classify this policy separately from intrinsic trigonometric constants.

additional_connected_scope.range_owner: Replace native min/max forwarding with optional named checked bounds; empty owned support is currently allowed by source-geometry admission, so do not assume nonempty.
additional_connected_scope.tree_retention: TreePresentationCache.terrain_height_range is Vec2 retained through bark_for_terrain, species wrappers and bark_material. Carry checked bounds to the Vec4 uniform endpoint, and couple image/range availability so no default range or stale other-scene binding can be used.
additional_connected_scope.weather: apply_active_scene_weather clears old particles before admission; missing bounds can explicitly prevent rendering. update_weather_occlusion_map must not claim an update or retain a mismatched range.
additional_connected_scope.capture: setup_scene returns Bevy Result; make required height/range selection fallible before command publication. Animation capture has its existing terminal admission channel.
additional_connected_scope.spawn: spawn_connected_player currently creates enemy entity before terrain lookup and drains connected-player events. Support admission must precede entity publication and use an explicit reject/wait policy; do not silently consume a request as a successful spawn.
additional_connected_scope.landforms: Fault-scarp samples can collect TerrainRecipeResult; general marching callback must carry a fallible field through sample_field if source query can fail. Preserve arithmetic and deterministic visitation. Existing native fixtures only are adapted.
